dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a concave spline curvature from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded geometry with a medium-scale pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.3:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex arc forming a continuous curve from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a visible length approximately equal to the melon's vertical thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the transition point between the distal melon and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Caudal fin exhibits sharp, angular terminal lobes and a deep, well-defined median notch.
